articles.title: Microsoft CEO Discusses Critical Infrastructure Security
articles.summary: Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella addressed the growing concerns surrounding AI-driven cyberattacks, noting that much of the world's critical connected infrastructure remains difficult to patch. He also discussed how artificial intelligence brings both new security challenges and operational opportunities.

articles.title: Satya Nadella Predicts AI Agents Will Reshuffle Web Economics
articles.summary: Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella stated that upcoming AI agents could severely disrupt advertising-driven business models on the internet. This shift may force major companies like Amazon to completely rethink how they compete for customers in the digital marketplace.

articles.title: Anthropic Reportedly Prices IPO Above Projected Range at $83
articles.summary: Anthropic has reportedly priced its initial public offering at $83 per share, coming in above its previously projected range. This long-awaited market debut values the artificial intelligence company at an impressive $1.5 trillion on a fully diluted basis.

articles.title: Snapchat Enables AI-Powered AR Lens Creation
articles.summary: Snapchat now allows developers to build augmented reality lenses using AI assistants like Claude Code and Cursor. Creators can simply describe the lens they want in plain language, and the integrated AI assistant handles the entire building process.

articles.title: Payhawk Secures $280 Million Funding Round at $2 Billion Valuation
articles.summary: Enterprise financial management platform Payhawk has announced a massive $280 million funding round, pushing its valuation to $2 billion. Founded in 2018, the platform helps companies track expenses and handle procurement using specialized AI agents.

articles.title: Major School Districts Consider Dropping Google Search
articles.summary: Large school districts in New York, Los Angeles, and Chicago are evaluating Google Search alternatives. This comes after Google announced it will disable search access for schools that opt out of its mandatory Gemini-powered AI features starting next year.

articles.title: Instagram Introduces Post-Sharing Story Edits
articles.summary: Instagram has launched a new update allowing users to edit their published Stories for up to 15 minutes after sharing. Users can modify text, music, stickers, and drawings without losing any accumulated views, likes, or replies.

articles.title: Ukraine Uses Relay Drones to Bypass Starlink Limits
articles.summary: Ukraine successfully carried out a strike on a bridge using homegrown technology and relay drones to bypass Starlink communication limitations. The operation demonstrated how the military is adapting battlefield lessons from its adversary.

articles.title: Measles Outbreaks Cause US to Lose Elimination Status
articles.summary: Measles has become endemic in the United States, causing the nation to officially lose its long-held disease elimination status. Health data indicates that the spread of the preventable illness has been actively accelerating across the country.

articles.title: Waymo Pauses San Francisco Service Due to Flooded Streets
articles.summary: Waymo temporarily halted its robotaxi service in San Francisco after several autonomous vehicles became stuck and created traffic jams. The disruption occurred when the vehicles were unable to safely navigate flooded streets during a severe local storm.
